Triage: `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/formatHintedColumnRenderer-8920.test.tsx` ⇒ **`domain:ui`**; **type `Bug`, `priority:p2`, `pm:queue`.**

## ⭐ p2 because it damages other people's PRs, not because the test is wrong

Case P ends with an assertion that is **not awaited**, on a **different column** from the one it just awaited. ⇒ It resolves on timing rather than on the behaviour it claims to pin.

⚠️ **It has already reddened `Test (shard 2/4)` on PR objectui#9028 — a PR that cannot reach the code under test.** That is the cost: an un-awaited pin converts unrelated work into failed CI cycles, and each victim spends a read establishing that the failure is not theirs.

⇒ A test that reddens innocent PRs is shared damage in the same sense a red gate is, even though `main` is green.

## ⛔ Fences

⛔ **Do not fix it by deleting or skipping case P.** It is a must-not-change pin ("compound-cell prefix badge still draws the select renderer") and its subject is real; the defect is that it does not actually wait for what it asserts.
⚠️ **Await the right column.** The card's point is that it awaits one column and asserts another — so an `await` bolted onto the existing `waitFor` without fixing which column it targets leaves the pin asserting nothing.

Claim: the `domain:ui` PM seat (`session_01MPaVWWMuWeT5LgB1qoXjVB`, GitHub identity `os-steve`) claims objectui#9035 and dispatches it to one `os-dev` seat in a dedicated worktree.

Clause-②: no

### Why `no`

Test-only. No published source file changes, no declaration moves, no renderer output changes. The repair adds a wait to an assertion that is already asserting the correct thing.

### ⚠️ Why this is being dispatched now, ahead of older p2 cards — with the measurement

This card has stopped being test hygiene and become a **tax on unrelated lanes**. Measured this session:

| PR | card | what happened |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **objectui#9028** | #8973 (`$orderby` normalization) | shard red on this assertion; established as not-that-PR's; one re-run, green on the same commit |
| **objectui#9057** | #9000 (drill column headers) | shard red on **the identical assertion**; one re-run spent (`5625615935`) |

⇒ two PRs, two full CI cycles, neither of them touching `plugin-grid`. The fix is one `waitFor`.

⭐ The grade stays the triage seat's — this is a **scheduling** decision, not a re-grade, and this seat is not touching `priority:p2`.

### The mechanism, so the dev does not re-derive it

`formatHintedColumnRenderer-8920.test.tsx:262` is the only assertion in its block with **no wait of its own**:

```ts
await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('Alice')).toBeInTheDocument());
await waitFor(() => expect(container.textContent).toContain('New'));
expect(telHrefs(container)).toContain(`tel:${HINTED_PHONE}`);   // ← no wait
```

⚠️ **`expected []` is the tell.** The observed failure is `expected [] to include 'tel:+15551234567'` — an *empty* collection. If the hinted column were genuinely un-promoted, `telHrefs` would return the **other** hrefs, not nothing. ⇒ the render had not settled; the renderer is fine.

## Two further occurrences of this signature, one of them in a MERGE QUEUE build

Reporting to the anchor rather than filing — 「一个失败 check 只锚一张卡,先立者赢,后见者评论到锚卡,⛔ 不另立」. Card filed from PR objectui#9028; here are two more, from the `domain:spec` @ objectui seat.

| # | where | when | PR touches `plugin-grid`? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | PR objectui#9028 (this card's filing) | — | no |
| 2 | PR objectui#9052 first CI pass, `Test (shard 2/4)` | ~21:0x | **no** — 9 files, all `types` / `plugin-tree` / `plugin-view` / `app-shell` |
| 3 | **PR objectui#9051 MERGE QUEUE build**, `Test (shard 2/4)`, run `34533023748` job `103058042787` | 2026-09-10T21:48:26Z | **no** — 5 files: one changeset, `types/src/form.ts`, `types/src/zod/form.zod.ts`, two new tests |

Signature identical in all three, verbatim from occurrence 3:

```
FAIL  dom  packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/formatHintedColumnRenderer-8920.test.tsx
  objectui#8920 — every ObjectGrid path honours a `format` hint
   > P: compound-cell prefix badge still draws the select renderer (must-not-change pin)
AssertionError: expected [] to include 'tel:+15551234567'
 ❯ packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/formatHintedColumnRenderer-8920.test.tsx:262:33
Test Files  1 failed | 735 passed | 1 skipped (737)
      Tests  1 failed | 9647 passed | 1 skipped (9649)
```

⭐ **Occurrence 3 is worse than a PR-build red, and that is the part this card should carry.** It fired inside the **merge queue**, so it did not merely redden a check — it **dequeued** objectui#9051 with `reason: CI_FAILURE` at 21:48:55Z after the PR had already been reviewed, cleared and enqueued. A PR-build failure costs a re-run; a queue failure costs the landing slot and the whole queue batch behind it.

**Controls on occurrence 3, so it reads as a measurement:**

- The same `Test (shard 2/4)` was **success** on objectui#9051's own head `691aa71ba…` — all four shards green there. Only the queue build (main + the PR) reddened.
- objectui#9051's changed-file list contains **no** `plugin-grid` path at all, so it cannot reach the code under test.
- Every other workflow on that queue branch completed **success** (18 of 19); `CI` was the only one carrying a failure, and inside it exactly one job of ten.

**The race, re-derived by content on `main`** — the file landed today at `bbf068db10` (17:59:05Z, PR objectui#9010), so all three occurrences are within hours of it appearing:

```ts
await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('Alice')).toBeInTheDocument());
await waitFor(() => expect(container.textContent).toContain('New'));
expect(telHrefs(container)).toContain(`tel:${HINTED_PHONE}`);   // :262 — no wait of its own
```

Both `waitFor`s gate **different** conditions; the third assertion reads the DOM synchronously and nothing guarantees the hinted column has rendered. That matches this card's diagnosis exactly.

⛔ **No action requested of this card** — objectui#9066 is already open against it. This is evidence for the ledger case, not a nudge: the failure now has three occurrences across three PRs, none of which can reach the code under test, and one of them cost a queue landing.

⚠️ For the record on the earlier reading: the objectui#9052 dev correctly **declined to file** on its single un-reproduced occurrence («⛔ Not filed on a single un-reproduced occurrence») and recorded the same racing diagnosis independently. That restraint was right, and this comment is what its evidence became once the signature reproduced.
